merge_rules.population: If a sourced enrichment population exists, expose it as properties.population while preserving statistics_provenance.population. Never overwrite geometry_source fields.
merge_rules.area_km2: If sourced enrichment area exists and canonical geometry lacks a sourced area, expose area_km2 and statistics_provenance.area_km2. Existing sourced geometry-side area wins unless enrichment explicitly has higher-priority reviewed status.
merge_rules.density_per_km2: Prefer explicit sourced density. Otherwise runtime may derive population / area only when both inputs are known and expose the calculation as derived, not source-observed.
